title: Polynomial-Time Computability of Nested Projection
statement: Define $g(z)=\pi_2(\pi_1(z))$, where $\pi_1$ and $\pi_2$ are the total first and second projections of the aligned pair parser, each returning the empty string when the input does not parse as a pair. Then $g$ is polynomial-time computable.
